title: Beyond Symmetric Agents: Cognitive Diversity and Multi-Agent Debate in Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.35875v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) reportedly improves reasoning and factuality over single-model inference, but prior work treats agents as symmetric peers, leaving open what drives the gains. We test the hypothesis that cognitive diversity among agents is the driver, in the setting where the question is still measurable: small open-weight models with benchmark headroom. Across 23 models from eleven vendor families, five tasks, and 5,500+ debate and control runs, we vary diversity along three axes - personas, sampling temperature, and model identity - pairing every debate configuration with a generation-budget-matched majority-vote control. The hypothesis is rejected on every axis. Debate beats single-agent inference (3--7 points where tasks have headroom) but at matched budget conditions it ties or even loses to self-consistency sampling at 1.6$\times$ the wall-clock and 3.4$\times$ the token cost. translated_title: 超越对称智能体：小语言模型中的认知多样性与多智能体辩论
translated_abstract: 据报道，多智能体辩论（MAD）相比单模型推理能够提升推理能力和事实准确性，但以往工作将智能体视为对称的对等体，留下了一个未解之谜：增益究竟由什么驱动。我们在问题仍然可测量的设定下检验了“智能体间的认知多样性是增益驱动因素”这一假设，即具有基准提升空间的小型开源权重模型。研究覆盖来自十一个厂商系列的23个模型、五项任务、5500多次辩论与对照实验，我们沿三个维度改变多样性——角色人设、采样温度和模型身份——并将每个辩论配置与生成预算匹配的多数投票对照组进行配对比较。该假设在所有维度上均被否定。辩论确实优于单智能体推理（在任务有提升空间时可提高3至7个百分点），但在匹配预算条件下，它以1.6倍的墙钟时间和3.4倍的令牌成本，与自洽性采样持平甚至表现更差。角色提示会降低准确率，并呈现剂量-反应关系。
tldr: 本文通过5500多次大规模对照实验发现，认知多样性并非多智能体辩论增益的驱动因素，且在匹配计算预算下，辩论方法不敌成本更低的自洽性采样，挑战了多智能体辩论的主流假设。
en_tdlr: Through 5,500+ large-scale controlled experiments, this paper rejects the hypothesis that cognitive diversity drives multi-agent debate gains, showing that under matched compute budgets debate ties or loses to cheaper self-consistency sampling.
